items.claim: Ian Garry is long, rangy, moves well, and is difficult to take down and hold down.
items.quote: He's long, rangy, moves really well. You don't often see him getting taken down and held there.

items.claim: Ian Garry is young, fresh, and does not have a lot of damage or miles on the clock.
items.quote: He's young, he's fresh, he's not had a, you know, loads of damage or anything like that. He's not got a lot of miles on the clock.

items.claim: Islam Makhachev is physically extremely strong, with people reporting he is the strongest person they have ever fought.
items.quote: People are saying there's reports across the board that he's the strongest person that people have ever fought.

items.claim: Ian Garry moves his feet very well and is hard for opponents to get a hold of.
items.quote: Ian Garry though, very tough guys to get hold of. Moves his feet really well.

items.claim: Islam Makhachev is getting a little bit older but is definitely still in his prime.
items.quote: Islam Makhachev. He's getting a little bit older now. But he's still in his prime. He's definitely still in his prime

items.claim: Ian Garry has never shown any signs of fatigue or getting tired late in fights.
items.quote: Ian's never showed any signs of like fatigue or getting tired late in the late rounds or anything like that.
